title: When every part in a bulk change fails the toast reads No parts were changed. and lists each reason
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 are active. Two browser tabs (A and B) on Parts > Inventory at Staging Heavy Duty. DevTools Network tab open in tab A.
custom_steps:
1. Tab A: the actions menu > Deactivate parts; tick QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2.
  2. Tab B: the actions menu > Deactivate parts; tick QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2, click Deactivate and confirm Deactivate.
  3. Tab A (not reloaded): click Deactivate on the bulk bar, then Deactivate (red) in the confirmation.
  4. Wait at least 20 seconds without touching the toast.
  5. Look at the list and the bulk bar in tab A, then close the toast with its close button.
  6. Open QAPL-T1's Part History.
  7. Tab B: Inactive tab > the actions menu > Activate parts; tick QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2, click Activate and confirm Activate.
custom_expected:
1. Bulk mode; the bar reads "2 selected".
  2. "2 parts updated."; both parts move to the Inactive tab in tab B.
  3. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status answers 200 with updated [] and both parts in failed. A red error toast (toast_bulk_status_failed) titled "No parts were changed." lists one line per part: "QAPL-T1: Part is already in that state." and "QAPL-T2: Part is already in that state."
  4. The toast is still on screen: it stays until closed.
  5. The list is not reloaded, both rows stay ticked ("2 selected") and bulk mode stays on, ready for a retry; the toast closes.
  6. Only the one "Deactivated" entry from tab B; the failed attempt wrote no entry.
  7. "2 parts updated."; both parts are back on the Active tab.
